name: Kelme
note: Spanish sportswear brand; the AFC's Official Technical Sponsor and match-ball supplier, extended to 2029 and covering ACL Elite, Asian Cup 2027 and more (Kelme, 2024-11-18). Espanyol's kit maker since 2018-19 (La Grada, 2026-03-26). Four-year kit deal with the Jordan Football Association signed 2026-05-18 (JFA). Kelme's legal notice names New Millennium Sports, S.L. as the owner of kelme.com. Not rated yet: 2Playbook (2021-10-25, https://www.2playbook.com/retail/kelme-espana-presenta-concurso-acreedores-perder-pulso-judicial-32-millones_5546_102.html) says New Millennium Sports owned the brand until 2019 and is now only its distributor in Spain; the brand passed to Kelme Sports International, 80% held by Kelme Sports Products, the new name of Jinjiang Yuanxiang Garments Weaving (China). Who owns that company isn't sourced.
